description: Adds an existing organization member to one of its teams, or may generate an access request when permission to join is needed. An already-existing membership is reported as an error.

inputSchema.description: Request to add an organization member to a team.

member_id.description: ID of the existing organization member to be added to the team.
member_id.title: Member Id

organization_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the organization. Slugs are typically lowercase and use hyphens.
organization_id_or_slug.title: Organization Id Or Slug

team_id_or_slug.description: The ID or slug of the team to which the member will be added. Slugs are typically lowercase and use hyphens.
team_id_or_slug.title: Team Id Or Slug

inputSchema.title: AddTeamMemberInOrganizationRequest

name: add_team_member_in_organization

AddTeamMemberInOrganizationResponse.description: Response after successfully adding an organization member to a team, returns the team object.

access.description: List of permissions granted to the user (e.g., 'event:read', 'event:write', 'team:read', 'org:read', 'project:read', 'member:read', 'project:releases', 'alerts:read').
access.title: Access

avatar.description: Contains avatar metadata for the team.
avatar.title: Avatar

dateCreated.description: Timestamp when the team was created (ISO 8601 date-time format, nullable).
dateCreated.title: Date Created

flags.description: Feature flags associated with the team, supporting additional properties like 'idp:provisioned'.
flags.title: Flags

hasAccess.description: Denotes whether the user has permissions to access team resources.
hasAccess.title: Has Access

isMember.description: Indicates whether the authenticated user belongs to this team.
isMember.title: Is Member

isPending.description: Shows if the user's membership is awaiting confirmation.
isPending.title: Is Pending

teamRole.description: The authenticated user's role within the team (nullable, e.g., 'contributor', 'admin').
teamRole.title: Team Role

AddTeamMemberInOrganizationResponse.title: AddTeamMemberInOrganizationResponse

avatarUuid.description: UUID of the uploaded avatar image (nullable).
avatarUuid.title: Avatar Uuid
